en.bdb: All gifts are with the grace of Oankaar, the Lord -

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਸੁ ਕਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: kisai ridh sidh kisai dhei kisai nidh karaamaat su kisai|

en.bdb: Upon some He bestows miraculous powers (riddhis, siddhis) and to some He gives wealth and to some other miracles.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਰਸਾਇਣ ਕਿਸੈ ਮਣਿ ਕਿਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਕਿਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: kisai rasain kisai man kis paaras kisai a(n)mirat risai|

en.bdb: To some He gives life-elixir, to some the fabulous gem, to some the philosopher's stone and due to His grace in the inner self of some trickles the nectar;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਿਸੈ ਵੀਰਾਰਾਧ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: ta(n)t ma(n)t paakha(n)dd kisai veeraaraadh dhisa(n)tar dhisai|

en.bdb: Some in His will practise tantra mantra hypocrisies and worship of Vas (S aivite worship) and some others He causes to wander in far off places.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤ ਕਿਸੈ ਲਖਮੀ ਦੇਵੈ ਜਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: kisai kaamadhen paarijaat kisai lakhamee dhevai jisai|

en.bdb: Upon some He bestows the wishfulfilling cow, upon some the wishfulfilling tree and on whomsoever He likes He bestows Laksami (goddess of wealth).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਟਕ ਚੇਟਕ ਆਸਣਾ ਨਿਵਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਮਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: naaTak cheTak aasanaa nivalee karam bharam bhau misai|

en.bdb: To delude many, He gives asans (postures), niolf kannas --the yogic exercises, and miracles and dramatic activities to many a person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਸਲਿਸੈ।
verses.translit_en: jogee bhogee jog bhog sadhaa sa(n)jog vijog salisai|

en.bdb: He gives asceticism to yogis and luxuries to bhogis (enjoyers of the wordly pleasures).
Meeting and parting i.e. taking birth and dying always cojointly exist. These all are (various) forms of Oankar.
